column1: # Statistics Denmark environmental-economic accounts by industry
# Long format: one row per (year
# Retrieved through the open StatBank REST API (https://api.statbank.dk/v1/data)
# Written by src/analysis/fetch_dst_accounts.py - re-run rather than edit by hand.
# DRIVHUS: Greenhouse Gas Accounts (in CO2 equivalents) - 117 industries via variable BRANCHE (industry)
# MRU1: Air Emission Accounts - 117 industries via variable BRANCHE (industry)
# ENE2HA: Energy Account in GJ (detailed table) - 117 industries via variable ANVEND (use)
# Industry codes are the six-digit DB07 codes (V + six digits)
# the Danish IO tables and by the StatBank waste tables AFF1MU1N / AFF3MU1N. Section and
# 69-grouping aggregates are excluded
# block are exhaustive and non-overlapping.
# These are DIRECT (territorial
# principles. DRIVHUS equals DRIVHUS2 with OPPRINCIP=DIR (verified); the FORDEL and
# BRUTTO principles of DRIVHUS2
# emissions onto the consuming industry
column2: are NOT used - the IO model derives that

column1: # reallocation itself and would otherwise count it twice.

#   energy_use:     ETOT = EROOL + EOIL + ENGI + ENGF + EKUKO + EAFFA + EVE + EKONV.
# DRIVHUS is published rounded to whole 1
